status_meaning: No gating check failed, but the external parent-polygon comparison (C6d) is NOT_EVALUABLE, so Gate C does not pass.
scope_of_topology_result: Both frozen datasets (native EPSG:32718, 11209 positions; normalized EPSG:4326, 11209 positions) were checked with exact predicates and no snapping. The union of the nine units is one simple loop of 4369 positions; the directed-edge certificate rules out positive-area overlap and internal gaps.

non_gating_findings.finding: No independently frozen parent N6 137596 (Cuenca Casma) polygon exists in the repository, so the union cannot be compared with an external parent. This is the only reason Gate C does not pass.

Service attribute AREA_KM2 minus the planar EPSG:32718 area of the same frozen polygon (km2): 1375961 -0.4234, 1375962 -0.2051, 1375963 -0.2180, 1375964 -0.0014, 1375965 -0.0034, 1375966 -0.0000, 1375967 0.0000, 1375968 -0.0000, 1375969 -0.0000; total -0.8514. The attribute is stale or computed differently for the three downstream units; the geometry itself is unaffected.
Service attribute AREA_FINAL is 0.36-0.40 % below the WGS84 ellipsoidal area in every unit (total 2973.9707 vs 2985.0802 km2). Its definition is not documented by the service; not interpreted.

Planar EPSG:32718 area exceeds the WGS84 ellipsoidal area by 0.188 % (2990.6900 vs 2985.0802 km2). The basin spans 78.39-77.62 W; 4715 of 11209 positions lie west of 78 W, outside the nominal UTM zone 18 band, with point scale 1.0006-1.0013. Areas measured in the storage CRS are therefore not true areas. Equal-area cross-check CEA vs Albers agrees to 1.7e-9 relative.

The planar EPSG:32718 area of the frozen geometry rounds to the 2007 one-decimal inventory area in 8 of 9 units; 1375968 (Pira) differs by +0.0502 km2 (planar 164.7498, inventory 164.8). Recorded only as an observation for Gate B reviewers: area agreement is necessary but not sufficient for geometric equivalence, no equivalence is asserted, and Gate B is unchanged.

Adjacencies beyond the required main-stem pattern (shared boundary, metres): 1375962-1375964 21694.59, 1375964-1375969 8998.52, 1375965-1375969 11582.50, 1375966-1375968 18214.90. Permitted by the Pfafstetter definition (shared divides away from the main stem); informational.
Native Esri shells are clockwise; the normalized GeoJSON shells are counter-clockwise (RFC 7946 right-hand rule). Both are internally consistent; informational.

relation_to_existing_gate_adjudication.consistency: Reproduces the recorded PARTIAL_PASS_INTERNAL_TOPOLOGY__PARENT_CONTEXT_PENDING with exact predicates, touch/T-junction detection, a directed-edge overlap/gap certificate and QA of the publication-CRS geometry. Its geometric_area_sum_km2 (2990.689973...) is the planar EPSG:32718 area, not the ellipsoidal area (see F4).

Preregister the parent comparison metric and tolerance (for example symmetric-difference area and Hausdorff distance in an equal-area CRS) before inspecting that geometry, and record whether the parent shares lineage with the MINAM coverage.
